tools.name: Julia lock conflict counters
tools.purpose: observed ReentrantLock contention in verified operations
tools.limitations: Counts do not establish waiting duration, native lock behavior or scalability.

tools.name: Valgrind Memcheck
tools.purpose: Native invalid accesses and definite leaks
tools.limitations: Julia JIT requires smc-check; suppressions and sometimes a MEMDEBUG build are needed. Instrumented runtime is not benchmark latency.

tools.name: Valgrind Callgrind
tools.purpose: Instruction attribution and call relationships
tools.limitations: Instruction counts are not wall time. JIT attribution and warmup need separate validation.

tools.name: Valgrind Cachegrind
tools.purpose: Simulated cache and branch behavior
tools.limitations: Simulation is not a measurement of the actual processor cache hierarchy.

tools.name: Valgrind Massif
tools.purpose: Native heap growth and peak allocation trees
tools.limitations: Allocator interception differs from Julia GC object accounting; startup and profiler overhead remain in scope.

tools.name: heaptrack
tools.purpose: Native allocation call stacks, temporary allocations and leaks
tools.limitations: Interposed allocator calls do not enumerate every Julia object. Debug symbols determine attribution.

tools.name: AddressSanitizer / MemorySanitizer / ThreadSanitizer
tools.purpose: Instrumented runtime and native dependency memory or race defects
tools.limitations: Requires compatible instrumented builds; not a profiler or portable switch on stock Julia.

tools.name: Tracy / Julia timing zones
tools.purpose: Runtime phases and annotated timelines
tools.limitations: Requires Julia built with the corresponding profiler support; zones are not sampled call stacks.

tools.name: DTrace / bpftrace
tools.purpose: Runtime probes and kernel/user event correlation
tools.limitations: Build support, trace permissions and available probes vary. System-wide events need attribution.

tools.name: TestItemRunner
tools.purpose: Existing test item lifecycle cost without duplicating workload definitions
tools.limitations: Optional extension; measures setup, imports, assertions and cleanup. Does not change upstream default tag selection.
